beats.text: Aling Nena approaches Marites about her child. As a BHW, Marites works with the midwife in the health team.
Marites asks what help is needed. She listens and checks what she understood instead of guessing at an illness.
Marites acts only within her training, local policy, and supervision. If she is unsure, she seeks guidance from the midwife.
She confirms the appropriate health worker or facility. She explains whom to contact and how to get there.
Following the health team's instructions, Marites confirms what to record, when to follow up, and whom to update.
If Aling Nena asks for medicine advice beyond Marites's training, Marites listens, seeks guidance, explains the next step, and follows through.
